virality_data.topic: Building an engineering agent skill system from a local .agents directory using markdown workflows
virality_data.analysis: Agent developer tooling is exploding right now with Matt Pocock's skills framework and obra/superpowers simultaneously leading GitHub trends. Rather than bloated agent frameworks with heavy dependencies, developers are rapidly pivoting to transparent filesystem-based skill loops stored in markdown. This post provides an immediately copyable, 75-line agent runner that parses executable shell actions and context directly from a local `.agents/` folder.

GitHub Trending: obra/superpowers (Agentic skills framework & software development methodology)

virality_data.story_angle: After Cursor extensions caused security panics, I ditched bloated third-party agent harnesses and built a transparent, file-based skill runner directly inside my repo's `.agents` directory.

virality_data.topic: Extracting carrier settings and binary profile blobs across major mobile brands without vendor SDKs
virality_data.analysis: Telecom configurations and APN payload reverse-engineering usually live behind NDA paywalls or messy forum threads, making carrier-explode an instant hit on Hacker News with over 430 points. Telecom, IoT, and embedded automation engineers waste days extracting hidden carrier bundles, baseband rules, and MMS gateways from iOS `.ipcc` files and Android system images. This tutorial bridges Python automation into cellular engineering by showing how to batch-extract, unpack, and normalize raw carrier configuration payloads into clean JSON.
cross_source_signals: Hacker News Show HN: Carrier-Explode hit 433 points and 55 comments
Reddit r/reverseengineering: Growing interest in extraction pipelines for mobile carrier bundles
GitHub: carrier-explode open-source configuration decoder trending
virality_data.money_angle: Telecom QA automation and enterprise SIM provisioning tools charge steep recurring enterprise licensing fees for this exact dataset.
virality_data.story_angle: I needed to test roaming behavior for an IoT tracker without buying twenty SIM cards, so I built an automated scraper that decompresses carrier settings across iPhone, Pixel, and Galaxy firmwares.
virality_data.suman_angle: Telecom Automation: How I Batch-Parsed 500 Carrier Firmware Configs into Clean JSON with Python
virality_data.competing_articles: Existing cellular guides are vague carrier manuals; this is an automated, runnable script that rips apart binary archives into structured data.

virality_data.topic: Building a zero-backend interactive 90s aesthetic generator using raw SVG filters and modern Canvas
